story_rules: show a concrete action before exposing the hidden mechanism
preserve one visual anchor across representation changes
use text as a label, not as the primary explanation
hold the resolved state long enough to read

design: exaggerated limb arcs and asymmetrical poses
large facial features with minimal detail
background built from two or three large color fields
motion: hidden anatomy is revealed through silhouette or panel replacement

design: body-wide mechanism represented as a circuit map

wall deformation and particle flow explain pressure
pathology accumulates instead of appearing instantly
